title: Amor fati
idea: Love your fate. Do not just put up with what happens. Want it, including the hard parts, because it is your life.
apply: Take one thing you resent from the past year and write one sentence on what it gave you.
remind: Do not just endure it. Embrace it.
who: Lena, who still resents being laid off last year.

scenes.nar: A year ago, Lena was laid off. She still replays it, and she wishes it had never happened.
Nietzsche urged more than endurance. Not just putting up with fate, but loving it. Wishing it away keeps her stuck.

items.x: A push to leave a job she disliked
Courage she did not know she had

scenes.nar: So Lena asks what it gave her. A push to leave a job she disliked. Time to learn design. And courage she did not know she had.
She now says, I would not erase it. She has three design clients, and the bitterness is gone.
